notes.title: Demo out now!
notes.notes: [h1]Added Difficulty[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629308/040e60a91f7f3168f0e1d5058abe2e3d11ad4b50.png"][/img]There really wasn't much of a challenge once the controls posed no issue. So, I decided to add a few obstacles to each of the areas. Hopefully this should make it a bit more enjoyable.[/p][p][/p][p]I've been hearing a few issues with UI scaling for wide screens and have fixed them in the latest update. Upon launching I'll be fixing as many bugs as I can so let me know about them on X @HENRY_MEAD_[/p][p][/p][p]Also, I've been seeing a few of you in-game so if you had a random player join, it might've been me![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="h-N4xjqkEDU;full"][/previewyoutube][p]At the moment, there's no offline mode, so if you want to play on your ones, just host a game and hope no one joins (sorry bout that). It's to come in the final release which is next month! So make sure you wishlist upstairs today, I'd appreciate it and it helps me stay consistent up to launch![/p]
